title: Constructing Deployment Scenarios for Reserve Deliverability via Adaptive Robust Optimization
summary: Network congestion often hinders the deployment of reserves needed to balance forecast errors during real-time operations. A pertinent idea to tackle this challenge involves adding deployment scenarios of spatial distributions of forecast errors as contingencies to the day-ahead problem. However, current approaches disregard the effect of grid topology and the day-ahead schedule on the induced congestion and, consequently, reserve deliverability.
